column2: # 1. Filtriramo samo numeričke kolone i uklanjamo 'id' ako je ostao
# 2. Uzimamo reprezentativni uzorak od 5000 redova radi uštede memorije
# 3. Pokretanje brze MICE imputacije za test
Hawkins' test is significant; if multivariate normality can be assumed, then reject the assumption that missingness is MCAR.
Anderson-Darling test is not significant. There is thus evidence against multivariate normality, but not against MCAR.
